title: Giuseppe Tomis - Software Engineer
description: Giuseppe Tomis, software architect and software engineer specialized in AWS cloud and Kubernetes (K8s). Contact me for consulting and new software projects.

about.titleStart: Engineering that turns complexity into something
about.p1: I'm a software engineer who works end to end — architecting cloud infrastructure, building the services that run on it, and crafting the front-ends that sit on top. I care about systems that stay calm under load and code that the next engineer can actually read.
about.p2: My toolkit centers on AWS, Kubernetes, and modern web stacks, backed by certifications that keep my practice sharp. Whether it's a greenfield product or untangling legacy infrastructure, I bring clarity, ownership, and a bias toward shipping.
